root.name: Zukertort Opening: Pachman Gambit
root.moves: 1. Nf3 d5 2. e3 c5 3. c4 dxc4 4. b3

overview: White plays Nf3, e3, c4 against the Slav-type setup ...d5, ...c5, then answers ...dxc4 with b3. If Black takes bxc4 White opens the b-file and the a-file and fianchettoes the queen's bishop. The idea is to regain the pawn with a lead in development. Rare, so I am reasoning from the moves.

white_ideas.idea: Open lines with b3 and Bb2 and regain the pawn
Lead in development and pressure on the long diagonal

black_ideas.idea: Keep the c4 pawn with ...b5 or accept b3 by ...cxb3

typical_structures.structure: Black has pawn on c4 and c5, White fianchetto on b2

character.notes: A pawn down for activity yields real risk.

gambit.reason: White gives the c4 pawn for development.

plans.reason: White uses the b2 bishop and development to regain the pawn.
